top5.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO after initially rejecting his return
top5.description: Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as chairman, chief executive officer, and director five days after rejecting his return. The independent investigation continues, while Nvidia shares rebounded sharply after the announcement.
top5.why: Nvidia’s reinstatement of Jensen Huang after an investigation creates immediate leadership, governance and market implications for the most strategically important AI-chip company.

top5.title: CrowdStrike acquires Zscaler in the largest cybersecurity deal
top5.description: CrowdStrike will acquire Zscaler in an all-stock transaction. The combined company will cover enterprise security from devices to the cloud.
top5.why: CrowdStrike’s all-stock acquisition of Zscaler would create a major end-to-end cybersecurity platform and reshape competition in enterprise security.

top5.title: Virginia and Oregon sue Elon Musk’s companies
top5.description: Virginia and Oregon have sued Elon Musk’s companies, alleging that Grok lacked adequate safeguards against child sexual abuse material and non-consensual intimate images. These are allegations, not judicial findings.
top5.why: Virginia and Oregon’s lawsuits against Elon Musk’s companies could bring significant legal, regulatory and reputational consequences for AI safety and platform governance.

top5.title: The EU Chips Act Unlocks €33 Billion in Investment
top5.description: Europe has unlocked €33 billion to revive its semiconductor industry, with new factories, GaN power-production sites, and packaging and testing lines spread across more than 20 projects. However, commercial production will not begin immediately.
top5.why: The EU Chips Act’s €33 billion investment package signals a major effort to strengthen Europe’s semiconductor capacity and reduce supply-chain dependence.

top5.title: OpenAI deploys GPT-6.2 Sol in ChatGPT’s Chat tab
top5.description: OpenAI is adding a chat-optimized version of GPT-6.2 Sol to ChatGPT’s Chat tab. Sol and Astra are also available in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API; OpenAI says Sol delivers performance close to Astra’s at about one-fifth the cost.
top5.why: OpenAI’s lower-cost GPT-6.2 Sol deployment could materially change the economics of everyday AI use across ChatGPT, enterprise products and APIs.
